upcoming meeting with DA Coleman on disinformation
[contact omitted] Vera Zakem Thursday, August 18, 2022 at 8:00:00 AM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted], [contact omitted], [contact omitted], [contact omitted] Diana Putman,
[contact omitted] Marcela Escobari, [contact omitted] Maura Barry, [contact omitted] Karl Fickenscher,
[contact omitted], [contact omitted], [contact omitted] Robert Jenkins, [contact omitted] Michele Sumilas,
[contact omitted] Jodi Herman, [contact omitted] John Voorhees
Cc: [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh, [contact omitted] DRG Troika, [contact omitted] David Black,
[contact omitted] Emily Green, [contact omitted] Meral Karan, [contact omitted] Lauren Kirby, [contact omitted]
Diana Parzik
Dear All,
We look forward to seeing you on Friday with DA Coleman, where we will discuss the Agency's
efforts to address disinformation. By way of background and for those who have not had a
chance to meet yet, I joined the DRG Center about three months ago as the Senior Advisor for
Tech and Democracy to help lead the Agency's efforts on digital democracy and combating
mis/dis/malinformation.
The purpose of this meeting will be to begin a discussion on how the Agency can better respond to
the ever growing threat of disinformation, and share more information about the "Information
Resilience Council" we are seeking to stand up. The Administrator has urged us to explore such a
Council as quickly as possible, and you will all receive an Action Memo for clearance in the next
week or two proposing its basic parameters. After initial introductions and opening remarks from
DA Coleman, I will provide an overview of key lines of effort and initiatives we hope this Council will
take on and coordinate across the Agency. We will then open the floor to your insights and
questions.
As this process gets underway, we would like to request your input on the following items:
• Please ID a senior level POC (either you or a DAA) to attend roughly bimonthly senior
level meetings like this one.
• Consider who in your Bureau at the technical level who can give a portion of their time
to participate in the working group that will carry out much of the Council's substantive
work.
• Consider what the main challenges to your bureau are related to this issue, and how an
optimal Council might meaningfully address them.
Thanks so much, and please let me know if you have any questions!
Vera
[contact omitted] Karl Fickenscher Thursday, August 18, 2022 at 9:26:50 AM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Johnny Brendan Walsh
